PluginManifest.Name: GameServerAuth
PluginManifest.Description: Game Server Auth is a plugin and web control plane for Discord-based server access. Players link their Discord and Steam accounts once, then authorize in-game with !accept. Server owners can claim Discord guilds, map Discord roles to promote levels and reserved-slot access, and push config updates to live game server nodes from a web dashboard. It supports single servers and multi-node clusters, including optional unauthorized-player kick or lobby redirect behavior when configured. The system keeps role-based access centralized and gives cluster owners a cleaner way to manage who can join.
PluginManifest.Author: OwendB
